name: plan creation: consult the IWC registry before drafting
description: The drafting procedure tells the agent to search the IWC workflow registry first and, on a full match, propose a single invocation rather than a step-by-step plan. Nothing asserted that until now, so the instruction was carried without evidence it changes behaviour. The request names a workflow-shaped task that IWC covers, and the assertion is on the search call rather than on which workflow is chosen -- the registry's contents move, and the behaviour under test is consulting it before deciding, not picking a particular entry.
inputs: I have paired-end Illumina reads and want a standard quality-control and contamination-screening run before assembly. Draft a plan; don't execute anything yet.
